topic: Abstract Vector Spaces: Moving Beyond Arrows

sections.title: Review: The Geometric Foundation
lecture_lines: Vectors are objects that follow two rules.
Addition combines vectors; scalar multiplication scales them.
Visualize this as stretching arrows on a grid.

sections.title: The Leap to Abstraction
lecture_lines: Functions, matrices, and polynomials can be vectors.
They must satisfy eight specific algebraic axioms.
animations: Show an arrow transforming into a function symbol. (#FFFFFF)

sections.title: Testing the Rules: The Axiom Checklist
lecture_lines: The eight axioms define a vector space.
Test each axiom to verify the space.
One failed axiom rejects the set.

sections.title: Visualizing Abstract Spaces
lecture_lines: Operations share the same underlying logic.

sections.title: Conclusion & Takeaway
lecture_lines: Abstract vector spaces offer a universal language.
They describe structure in complex systems.
Linear algebra provides this powerful framework.
